name: Warp Deformer Alt Symmetry
description: Extends bounding-box Alt symmetric semantics to Warp Deformer control points: Alt drags mirror across the vertical grid axis, Alt+Shift across the horizontal grid axis.

permissions.reason: Snapshots Warp Deformer grids on Alt press and diffs them on release to detect the dragged control points.
Commits the mirrored control-point positions through replaceGrid so the symmetric move joins native Undo/Redo.
Adds the mirror-axis toggle button to the canvas-top control strip.
Shows the armed-axis hint over the drawing area in the host's native lower-right hint surface and clears it on disarm.
